inputs_read.red_team J4 d_dispersion: Per arm and FAM-1 (class, m) at 30-32: D_A_hat = [sum_j (d_j - (kappa_hat - 1) nbar_j)^2 - sum_j s_j^2/3] / sum_j nbar_j, rho = D_A_hat/D_R_hat, curve-cluster bootstrap 95% CI. Structured arms: rho 0.61-1.22, every CI containing 1 except small_x TT5 0.825 [0.676, 0.983] and dickson TB3 0.717 [0.479, 0.991] (both LESS dispersed: conservative). small_x TT4 1.148 [0.998, 1.307]. Known-null arms 0.80-1.44, all CIs containing 1. At each cell's upper rho the z values only fall (small_x TT4 2.67 -> 2.41), so no reading changes and t* could only rise. X_rel is unchanged at grid resolution in all 21 cells even at the upper rho: at the frozen criterion P(z > t*) = 0.5 the detection limit is where E[z] = t*, which an arm-dispersion error does not move to first order; the prior's "X_rel too optimistic" route through dispersion is structurally closed, and only t*'s family-wise rate is exposed to it.
